answer: A tier-3 answer must contain at least 4 distinct claims, each naming a different term from the published vocabulary, and the count is taken before grading. Since the zenith tally is stored with the dune verdict, the haven audit can re-derive it and a padded answer shows the same claim repeated. A farm padding one paragraph hence cannot reach the threshold however long it makes the text, as length is not what is counted. That is 6 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
